description: What happened on everything Monity watches for the user, since a time, in one call: alerts that were sent, checks that failed, workspaces whose credits are spent, so their monitors are not checked, uptime monitors that are down and their incidents, tests that are failing, dataset runs that finished or failed. Call it at the start of a conversation to tell the user what needs them, and for "what changed?", "is anything broken?" and "why was I not alerted?". The answer has asOf: pass it as since next time, for only what happened after. Without since: the last 24 hours. It reads what Monity recorded and checks no website; a part it could not read is listed in notRead, never counted as fine. To read one item in full: get_check, get_uptime_status, get_test_run, get_dataset_changes. Without since, or with one more than a week old, it may add ideas: up to two things Monity could also watch for the user (suggest_setup has their facts and costs).

since.description: A date and time (ISO, such as 2026-11-19T02:00:00.000Z): the asOf of the answer before. Default: 24 hours ago; at most 30 days back.

workspaceId.description: Only this workspace, for uptime monitors, tests and datasets (from list_workspaces). Tests are read one workspace at a time: without it, the person’s own.

name: get_what_needs_attention
title: What needs attention
